text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.
- A British court has ordered Zambia to pay over 24 billion kwacha for defaulting on an international refinancing agreement with Exprinter International Bank NV in 1984.
- President Chiluba has asked his ministers to declare their assets in the high court before a January 2 deadline.

- Former legal affairs minister Remmy Mushota has filed a petition in the high court seeking to a court order to have action taken against former president Kenneth Kaunda and other opposition leaders for advocating civil disobedience.
- Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe has congratulated president Frederick Chiluba on his landslide victory in presidential elections held on November 18.
- Inflation fell by 2.4 percent in November from October, the central statistics office said.
